excerpt_i18n.en: On October 28, the 2025 third-quarter reports of public funds were fully disclosed. According to data from Tianxiang Investment Advisors, CATL regained its position as the top holding in public funds, with a market value held by these funds reaching 75.881 billion yuan. In the third quarter, the technology sector performed strongly, and public funds focused their increased holdings in this area, with most of the top ten stocks they added being technology companies, particularly in AI-related segments such as optical modules. Regarding the significant increase in tech stock holdings by public funds, Li Xiaoxing, a fund manager at Yinhua Fund, stated that AI remains the main theme of global technological innovation. Domestic demand for computing power is robust, supply chain bottlenecks are gradually being resolved, and high growth is anticipated for the next year.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 28 de octubre, se completó la divulgación de los informes del tercer trimestre de 2025 de los fondos de inversión públicos. Según datos proporcionados por Tianxiang Investment Consulting, Contemporary Amperex Technology Limited recuperó el primer puesto como la mayor tenencia de los fondos, con un valor de mercado en manos de estos fondos de 75.881 mil millones de yuanes. En el tercer trimestre, el sector tecnológico destacó, y la dirección de las adiciones de los fondos se centró en esta área; entre las diez principales acciones que aumentaron, la mayoría eran tecnológicas, especialmente en segmentos relacionados con la inteligencia artificial, como los módulos ópticos. Sobre esta fuerte adición de acciones tecnológicas, Li Xiaoxing, gestor de fondos de Yinhua Fund, señaló que la IA sigue siendo la línea principal de la innovación tecnológica global. La demanda de capacidad de cálculo nacional es robusta, los cuellos de botella en la cadena de suministro se están resolviendo gradualmente, y se espera un alto crecimiento para el próximo año.

excerpt_i18n.en: A few days ago, an experiment called the "AI Trading Battle" gained popularity on overseas social media. The organizers gave six major models, including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, $10,000 in virtual funds each to freely trade cryptocurrencies. The results were surprising: as of today, DeepSeek V3.1 achieved an impressive profit rate of over 126%, while GPT 5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro fell below $5,000, with loss rates exceeding 50%. This "AI trading show" was originally intended to showcase the financial potential of intelligence but instead revealed a deeper issue: when faced with complex and dynamic financial environments, do language models understand why they place orders? A recent paper by a joint research team from Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Rutgers University in the U.S., and Nankai University provides an answer to such questions. They proposed a method called RETuning, which enables large language models to gather evidence, analyze logic, reflect on reasoning, and then draw conclusions before making predictions. In other words, the models no longer rely on intuitive judgments but have learned to think with sound reasoning. The research team systematically validated this method using a large-scale dataset covering China's A-share market. The results show that RETuning not only significantly improves prediction accuracy but also makes the model's reasoning process clearer and more credible.

items.raw_excerpt: 美团迈出通向“世界模型”的第一步，并计划用它更好地连接“原子世界”与“比特世界”。                    ▲美团发布并开源LongCat-Video视频生成模型，迈出通向“世界模型”的第一步（资料图） 10月27日，美团LongCat团队发布并开源LongCat-Video视频生成模型，以统一模型在文生、图生视频基础任务上达到开源SOTA（最先进水平），并依托原生视频续写任务预训练，实现分钟级长视频连贯生成，保障跨帧时序一致性与物理运动合理性，在长视频生成领域具备显著优势。 近年来，“世界模型”（World Model）因让人工智能真正理解、预测甚至重构真实世界，被业界视作通往下一代智能的核心引擎。作为能够建模物理规律、时空演化与场景逻辑的智能系统，“世界模型”赋予人工智能“看见”世界运行本质的能力。而视频生成模型有望成为构建世界模型的关键路径——通过视频生成任务压缩几何、语义、物理等多种形式的知识，人工智能得以在数字空间中模拟、推演乃至预演真实世界的运行。 正因如此，美团LongCat团队认为，此次发布的视频生成模型，是为探索“世界模型”迈出的第一步。未来，凭借精准重构真实世界运行状态的能力，LongCat模型也会融入公司近年来持续投入的自动驾驶、具身智能等深度交互业务场景中，成为公司更好连接“比特世界”和“原子世界”的技术基础。 ▲LongCat-Video视频生成模型视频推理速度提升至10.1倍（资料图）   具体来看，此次开源模型的技术报告显示，作为基于Diffusion Transformer（DiT）架构的多功能统一视频生成基座，LongCat-Video创新通过 “条件帧数量” 实现任务区分，原生支持三大核心任务：文生视频无需条件帧、图
